comparison.objective: Close a stayed tool-chest lid using its handle while operating the stay release; candidate extracts a terminal.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual sustained release and controlled lid lowering versus precision blade insertion and coordinated tool-wire pull.
comparison.success_condition: Lid rests flat, safely controlled and released; candidate requires terminal exit with connector integrity and no unintended extraction. Candidate thresholds are incomplete.
comparison.reason: Different objective, scale and force-control interaction.
